description: Evidence-led legend candidate clusters centered on a concrete site, surviving evidence, transmission, causal trace, guarded treasure, submerged settlement, ghost-vessel continuity, stone transformation, and advisory prophecy-lineage-return motifs.

visual_semantics.primary_visual_proposition: At one identifiable present-day site, a teller visibly connects a specific trace object to attentive listeners so place, evidence, and transmission coexist.
confusion_boundaries: tour group with no evidence object
book reading in an unrelated room

visual_semantics.primary_visual_proposition: A distinctive rock at a fixed site carries one anomalous human- or giant-scale trace whose shape, scale, and local reading make it the evidence object rather than scenery.
An extraordinary agent is caught in direct contact with terrain while one continuous deformation path becomes the named landform and leaves a readable result.
An adult seeker actively attempts to reach a fixed hidden cache, a guardian visibly interrupts that exact attempt, and the cache remains secured in place.
Several architectural elements remain joined to their foundations in a readable submerged settlement plan, with water, sediment, and scale evidence proving the in-situ context.

One identifiable working vessel remains materially readable while a bounded part of the same hull and rigging breaks into spectral absence, exposing former service residue and a present witness anomaly.
confusion_boundaries: translucent ship with no physical baseline

visual_semantics.primary_visual_proposition: One continuous subject visibly bridges living source anatomy into fixed site stone while source residue establishes the direction of change.
confusion_boundaries: completed petrified figure with no bridge

visual_semantics.primary_visual_proposition: An adult claimant, inherited relic, recorded prediction, public comparison, and immediate political consequence form an optional legend-cycle scene without treating any broad fate or lineage word as a hard pixel duty.
